coordinator_summary: Critical privacy violation identified. Agent Nabila disclosed patient Rachel Moore's full address (17 Lake Street) and sensitive test results (abnormal blood panel, medication discussion) aloud in a non-private shared office setting, directly against patient's explicit privacy objection. Agent further compounded the violation by dismissing patient concerns ("it is already in your chart"), showing poor empathy (2/10) and low professionalism (4/10). While call provided basic next-step clarity (Dr. Evans contact), the catastrophic privacy breach (2/10) and associated safety risk (5/10) represent serious HIPAA concerns. Patient demonstrated exemplary communication (respectfulness 8, clarity 9, cooperation 9) by appropriately asserting boundaries. Recommended actions: immediate retraining on privacy protocols, review call for compliance documentation, consider patient notification and remediation.
